title: Alistigo Node Standard
description: Alistigo's CALM Standard extending the core CALM node with alistigo-specific properties. Defines ddd-layer and core-npm-package as typed, validatable node properties. Custom node-type values (module, skill) are documented in $defs — CALM's node-type field accepts any string, so these are semantic definitions, not schema constraints.

ddd-layer.description: The DDD architectural layer this node belongs to. Required on module and system nodes.

core-npm-package.description: The primary npm package that implements this node (e.g. @alistigo/core-document). Required on module and system nodes except the Domain module, which is a pure DDD domain with no framework dependency.

node-type-module.title: module
node-type-module.description: A cohesive unit of functionality with a clearly defined boundary and at least one public interface. Implemented by one or more npm packages. A module enforces encapsulation: consumers interact only through its declared interfaces. Examples: domain, document, ui, storage, logger. Expected standard properties: ddd-layer (required), core-npm-package (required except Domain).

node-type-skill.title: skill
node-type-skill.description: An AI agent capability definition node. A skill has no runtime code dependencies — it is a documentation and metadata asset (SKILL.md + optional JSON schema) that describes how an AI agent should generate, configure, and interact with an artifact. Published as an npm package and loaded on demand by AI chat interfaces and agent runtimes. ddd-layer and core-npm-package do not apply to this node type.

node-type-system.title: system
node-type-system.description: A deployable or composable system that wires together multiple modules. In alistigo's context this is typically the Artifact node — the composition root that assembles domain, document, UI, storage, and logger modules and injects plugins at startup. Expected standard properties: ddd-layer (optional), core-npm-package (optional).
